definition: La variedad de vida vegetal y animal presente en un ecosistema o hábitat específico.
exampleSentence: Rainforests possess extraordinary biodiversity, housing millions of distinct organisms.

definition: Combinar diversos elementos o ideas para formar un sistema o conclusión coherente.
exampleSentence: The author managed to synthesize multiple historical perspectives into a unified narrative.

definition: Muy extendido, común o frecuente en un lugar o época determinada.
exampleSentence: Dry climatic conditions are highly prevalent in the arid southwestern regions.

definition: Cambiar continuamente entre diferentes niveles o estados de manera irregular.
exampleSentence: Market prices tend to fluctuate depending on supply and demand dynamics.

definition: Que parece razonable, creíble o probable según la evidencia existente.
exampleSentence: The astronomer presented a plausible explanation for the unusual orbital movement.
